body.prompt: The same hanok courtyard many years later in gentle falling snow, quiet and a little lonely. On the wooden maru porch, the grandmother's quilted plum vest lies neatly folded beside an empty teacup and her reading glasses. The persimmon tree is older and bigger, its last orange persimmons glowing at the top. Soft blue winter afternoon light with a warm glow from one paper window. Style: handcrafted 3D miniature diorama photographed with a macro lens, tilt-shift, shallow depth of field, soft cinematic light, felt, clay, paper and wood textures with tiny hand-painted details, gentle film grain, warm nostalgic color grade, clay figurines with soft rounded faces and deeply emotional Pixar-like expressions, not photorealistic. Vertical 9:16 frame, main subject in the middle of the frame, a calm uncluttered area in the top fifth of the frame. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no hangul, no logos, no labels, no brand names, no watermark anywhere.
